name: Raxxon
description: Destroy the Raxxon facility before it releases a mutant strain. Time is running out.

winCondition.description: Destroy all Raxxon containers before the final round ends.

specialRules.description: At the start of each round, add 1 zombie to a random location.

name: Kodiak Jack
description: Survive while a mysterious figure steals your supplies.

winCondition.description: Survive all rounds with morale above 0.

specialRules.description: At the end of each round, Kodiak Jack steals 1 food from the colony.

name: The Griswolds
description: A family of survivors must be escorted to safety without drawing zombies.

winCondition.description: Escort all Griswold family members to the colony.

lossConditions.description: A Griswold family member is killed.

specialRules.description: Griswolds add +1 zombie spawn per round while not at colony.

name: Don't Open the Door
description: Survive the night while something pounds on the colony doors.

winCondition.description: Survive until dawn (7 rounds) without opening the colony doors.

specialRules.description: Each round, roll a die. On 1-2, add 2 zombies to colony.

name: Fuel for a Fire
description: Gather enough fuel to burn the zombie horde before they overwhelm the colony.

winCondition.description: Collect 8 fuel cards and play them at the colony to burn the horde.

specialRules.description: Each round, zombies move 1 step closer. Colony gets +2 zombies at round 11.

name: A Nightmare to Remember
description: Recover lost memories of a survivor to reveal the colony's traitor.

winCondition.description: Recover all 5 memory fragments before the final round.

specialRules.description: Betrayer secretly destroys memory fragments each round.

name: Bandits
description: Fend off a bandit gang who raids the colony every other round.

winCondition.description: Survive all rounds while protecting the colony's supplies.

lossConditions.description: Colony has no food at the start of a round.

specialRules.description: Odd rounds: bandits steal 1 food and 1 random item from the colony.

name: The Long Road Ahead
description: Gather enough supplies to mount a full evacuation before the colony falls.

winCondition.description: Collect 3 food, 2 fuel, and 2 medicine by round 12.

lossConditions.description: The colony falls before evacuation is complete.

specialRules.description: Every 3 rounds, add 1 extra zombie to every location.
